rationale: Spawn eggs and admin items have no world origin; crafted_only is misleading as they are not crafted either

Tag minecraft:sulfur_cube_swallowable on calcite (and similar blocks) indicates a mob can physically ingest/swallow the block. No existing spawn_interaction value covers block-ingestion by a mob; attracts_mobs and mob_transport are both wrong in meaning.
Axes disable shield blocking for 5s on hit; no current value captures this

gray_glazed_terracotta carries tag minecraft:sulfur_cube_swallowable, implying a mob can consume or interact with it as a block; no existing environmental_property value covers block-consumption by mobs
Splash/lingering potions are primarily obtained via brewing stand; no current origin value captures this production pathway
Spawn eggs and admin-only items have no survival loot origin; crafted_only is misleading — a dedicated creative_inventory value would distinguish them cleanly
ignitable_by_fire doesn't capture netherrack's unique property that fire placed on it never extinguishes; distinct mechanic from merely being ignitable

name: native_biome
rationale: biome-endemic items like eyeblossom need biome context beyond overworld_surface
Tag minecraft:sulfur_cube_swallowable implies a mob (sulfur cube) can consume/swallow this block type; no existing spawn_interaction value captures this mechanic
Potions are primarily obtained via brewing stand; no existing origin value captures this production method
Tag piglin_repellents causes piglins to flee; distinct from piglin_pacifying (prevents aggression); soul torch, soul lantern, soul campfire all need this
Spectral arrow applies Glowing status effect to hit entities; not representable in current combat_bonus enum
Turtle eggs break when walked/jumped on by most entities
Player can climb up twisting vines (and weeping vines)

name: oxidation_stage
rationale: Copper has 4 stages (base/exposed/weathered/oxidized) plus waxed flag; useful for grouping copper variants in inventory UI

Weathered/exposed/oxidized copper variants have no production recipe and no natural loot table generation — obtained solely by natural oxidation of a placed copper item over time, or by scraping a more-oxidized stage. No existing origin value captures this mechanic.
